topics.title: Urlaubsvertretung im Büro
topics.englishContext: During the summer holiday season, colleagues may temporarily take over urgent tasks for one another. Teams often discuss open work, deadlines and who should handle questions while someone is away.

interestingFacts.de: In vielen deutschen Büros werden Abwesenheiten frühzeitig im Team angekündigt. Eine automatische Abwesenheitsnotiz informiert zusätzlich externe Kontakte über das Rückkehrdatum und eine mögliche Vertretung.
interestingFacts.en: In many German workplaces, absences are communicated to the team in advance. An automatic out-of-office message also tells external contacts when the employee will return and whom they can contact in urgent cases.

learnMore.title: Writing an Out-of-Office Email in Germany
learnMore.summary: See what a clear professional absence message should include, with a German example and English translation.

topics.title: Ein Tag am Badesee
topics.englishTitle: A day at a swimming lake
topics.englishContext: On warm summer days, many people visit an outdoor pool or swimming lake. Places with lawns, shade and a kiosk are especially popular, and visitors usually bring drinks, sunscreen and towels.

interestingFacts.de: Nicht jeder Badesee wird überwacht. Hinweise vor Ort zeigen, ob das Baden erlaubt ist, welche Bereiche geschützt sind und ob eine Badeaufsicht vorhanden ist.
interestingFacts.en: Not every swimming lake is supervised. Signs at the location indicate whether swimming is permitted, which areas are protected and whether lifeguards are present.

topics.title: Sommerfeste in der Nachbarschaft
topics.englishContext: During July, many towns and neighbourhoods organise small summer festivals with music, food, drinks and activities for children. They offer an informal opportunity to meet people who live nearby.

interestingFacts.de: Viele Stadtteil- und Nachbarschaftsfeste werden von Vereinen, Kirchengemeinden, Schulen oder lokalen Initiativen organisiert. Deshalb wirken sie oft persönlicher als große kommerzielle Veranstaltungen.
interestingFacts.en: Many neighbourhood festivals are organised by local associations, churches, schools or community initiatives. This often makes them feel more personal than large commercial events.

topics.title: Reisen mit leichtem Gepäck
topics.englishContext: Many people take short trips or weekend journeys during summer. Travelling with less luggage makes it easier to use buses and trains, change connections and move through stations.

interestingFacts.de: Auf vielen regionalen Bahnstrecken gibt es nur begrenzten Platz für große Koffer. Leichtes Gepäck erleichtert deshalb besonders das Umsteigen und Reisen mit Regionalzügen.
interestingFacts.en: Large suitcases can be inconvenient on regional trains, where luggage space may be limited. Light luggage therefore makes transfers and short rail journeys easier.
